content:
jin: quick design question: in the playground run preview, should we show small data badges (Amount, Status, Confidence) inline in compact rows or move them into an overflow panel? QA says screen readers speak the badges in a weird order right now.

maya: I vote inline for skimmability. but we must ensure SR order is predictable. badges should not be part of the accessible name; they should be exposed via an ordered description (aria-describedby) so we control narration order.

tom: inline visually but aria-hidden for each badge, then assemble a single offscreen summary string: e.g., "Amount: $1234. Status: Parsed. Confidence: 93%" and reference it from the row via aria-describedby. keeps visual density + good SR behavior.

rachel: agree. small copy nits: use sentence case on badge labels ("Amount", not "AMT") and avoid percent signs when possible for speech clarity ("ninety-three percent" vs "93%" will be read fine by the SR but numbers can be noisy). maybe we format to a short text: "93%" is fine but provide full text in the aria summary.

jin: what about keyboard users? the badge actions (copy, drill) need to be reachable without too many tab stops.

maya: suggestion: expose a single kebab (\u22ee) per row that opens a small menu with badge actions: Copy summary, Copy raw JSON, Open details. keep badges visual-only and make the kebab the single interactive affordance.

tom: if we do that, ensure the kebab menu announces the badges as options too (e.g., "Amount: $1,234") so keyboard/SR users can access badge data. also mark the menu with role="menu" and items role="menuitem".

jin: concern about discoverability: non-devs might not know the kebab hides important data. can we add a hoverable microhint: "details" when hovered/focused? and a tooltip that is accessible (not hover-only).

rachel: microcopy idea: the kebab tooltip says "Details & copy". concise. and show a small inline hint in the header like "Summary shown; details in menu" for new users (dismissible).

maya: performance angle: run history is virtualized. avoid creating menus for every row unless opened. implement menu as a single floating component that gets populated on open.

tom: also debounce keyboard live-region updates to avoid spam when arrowing (200ms). we should only update the offscreen summary when focus settles.

jin: testing: we need automated accessibility tests that confirm the aria-describedby text is present and matches visual badges for a few sample rows (long names, many badges). can we add NVDA and VoiceOver CI checks?

rachel: yes - i'll add small e2e a11y checks to the run-history suite. will include one case with long currency formatting and one chain of tool outputs.

ui-bot: note: branch "playground-badges-kebab" created from jin/ui. preview will be available after CI passes.

jin: summary + next steps:
- tom: implement kebab single-menu pattern + offscreen aria summary (eta Thu)
- maya: write a short a11y spec for aria-describedby assembly and SR strings (eta Wed)
- rachel: add e2e SR tests for two cases (eta Fri)
- jin: mock microhint and header hint variations (eta Tue)

maya: one more tiny copy nit: menu label should be "Details & copy" not "Copy & actions". phrase as the outcome.

tom: noted. i'll use that in the menu header.

jin: thanks all, i'll link the mock when ready. :thumbsup:
